title: Same Tree
statement: Given two binary trees, determine if they are the same. Two trees are the same if they are structurally identical and the nodes have the same values.
constraints: The number of nodes in each tree is in the range [0, 100]

visibleExamples.explanation: Both trees have the same structure and node values
The trees have the same structure but different node values

jsonFriendlyReason: Parameters p and q are TreeNode pointers, which require a custom tree adapter to serialize/deserialize.
